request.query: For a polynomial over a domain with real weights on variables, the minimum weight in the support of a product is the sum of the two minima.

items.name: MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder_mul
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [NoZeroDivisors R] (w : σ → ℕ) (f g : MvPowerSeries σ R),
  MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w (f * g) = MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w f + MvPowerSeries.weightedOrder w g

items.name: AddMonoidAlgebra.le_inf_support_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : Add A] [inst_4 : Add T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
    ∀ (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), f.support.inf degt + g.support.inf degt ≤ (f * g).support.inf degt

items.name: MvPolynomial.support_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : DecidableEq σ] (p q : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (p * q).support ⊆ p.support + q.support

items.name: MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous.mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {σ : Type u_3} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid M]
  {φ ψ : MvPolynomial σ R} {m n : M} {w : σ → M},
  MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w φ m →
    MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w ψ n → MvPolynomial.IsWeightedHomogeneous w (φ * ψ) (m + n)

items.name: Multiset.prod_min_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [inst : CommMonoid α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedMonoid α] {s : Multiset ι}
  {f g : ι → α}, (Multiset.map (fun i => min (f i) (g i)) s).prod ≤ min (Multiset.map f s).prod (Multiset.map g s).prod
